description: Materialize a template's carried-forward split_config (docs/04 §templates.split_config) against a confirmed occurrence amount that may differ from the config's own line sum (variable amount, edited amount, or a NEW-detected candidate whose amount is a group median while its split weights came from one source movement). Each line's owed_amount_cents is treated as a weight; shares are the weight's proportion of total_cents, floored, with the leftover remainder cents added to the payer's line (same convention as split_rounding's percentage method, spec §3.7). Identity when the config already reconciles with total_cents. A zero-weight line stays zero unless it is the payer.

cases.name: zero-weight line stays zero when not payer
